date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the page gives no earlier day for the forum post.
title: Decathlon confirms malicious access to customer personal data at an external provider; hacker "4me1" claims a forum post, reportedly with 137 000 email addresses
summary: Decathlon confirmed to Ouest-France "un accès malveillant à des données personnelles", at one of its external service providers, according to generation-nt. A hacker calling themselves "4me1" claims the attack on a forum; MCE TV, relaying Capital.fr, writes “plus de 137 000 adresses e-mail” (more than that number) are reportedly concerned; Wall-Street Tech cites a Cyberattaque.org analysis of 137.549 distinct email addresses. Generation-nt says Decathlon plans to notify the CNIL and affected customers by email.
plain: Decathlon has confirmed, according to generation-nt, that someone gained malicious access to customers’ personal data at an external provider. A hacker claims the attack; 137 000 email addresses are reportedly concerned.
exec: Decathlon confirmed malicious access to customer personal data at an external provider, per generation-nt; 137 000 email addresses are reportedly concerned, per MCE TV.
action: MCE TV advises being wary of unexpected messages about an order or parcel, not clicking links in suspicious SMS or emails, and checking on the official Decathlon site or app.

sources.name: generation-nt: Decathlon victime d'une fuite de données

validation.note: generation-nt relays Decathlon's statement to Ouest-France; the Ouest-France original was not read. MCE TV (relaying Capital.fr) and Money.pl report the forum claim. 01net, Les Numeriques, Cybernews, FMT and Astro Awani did not load.
